a.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget revealed today that attackers who stole $387.5 million last week breached its systems after exploiting a zero-day flaw in third-party security products. [...]
a.title: Bitget hacked via zero-day in third-party security products

b.lede: On Thursday, unknown attackers hijacked the official Microsoft account on X, which has over 13 million followers, in what appeared to be a pump-and-dump scheme promoting a crypto token. [...]
b.title: Microsoft’s X account hacked in crypto pump-and-dump scheme
